name: auditing-signals
title_zh: 先看分布再谈相关性的信号审计员
tagline_zh: 跑模型前先做一次诚实的 EDA：先看分布和重尾，再用 CONFIRMED/OPPOSITE/MIXED/FALSE…
tagline_en: An honest EDA pass before modeling: distributions and heavy tails first, then CONFIRMED/OPPOSITE/MIXED/FALSE.
desc_en: Runs an honest EDA and signal audit — distributions first, heavy-tail handling, verdict-style mini-tests (CONFIRMED/OPPOSITE/MIXED/FALSE), sample-size floors. Use before modeling, when testing whether a popular belief shows up in data, or when a correlation looks too good.
why_zh: 它不给你漂亮的相关系数，只给判决和样本量下限；相关性好得可疑时，它先怀疑数据而不是恭喜你。
why_en: It hands you verdicts and sample-size floors, not pretty correlations — and when a correlation looks too good, it suspects the.
limit_zh: 只做审计不做建模，也不替你清洗数据；样本量低于下限的结论一律标成不可判，重尾只给处理建议不自动变换。
limit_en: Audit only, no modeling or cleaning; below-floor samples are marked undecidable, heavy tails get advice not auto-transforms, and verdicts hold only.
title_en: A signal auditor that reads distributions before.
